/variant.note: Interblock Crapless Craps (GV 6.0+); on Las Vegas heads-up machines per VA.

/rules.note: Only 7 wins the come-out; 2, 3, 11 and 12 are points. No don't bets, so no bar; Pass "can only be placed before the come-out roll", so no put bets.

/money/payoutRounding.note: Fractional pays are floored to the cent: the conservative choice; no report exists for Interblock (rules spec §4.2, §9 #1).

/money/startingBankroll.note: Trainer default; not a machine value.

/money/betIncrement.note: Whole-dollar bets at a $1 denomination; chip and credit values scale with denomination.

/limits/min.note: $1 per bet; machines report $1 to $6 minimums.

/limits/max.note: $500 per wager, the Washington tribal ETG cap; casino maximums vary.

/limits/minTotal.note: "BETS ARE NOT VALID YET! – Must bet N credits more!"; OFF bets do not satisfy it.

/limits/minTotal/amount.note: $5 total: crapless minimums are reported at $1 to $6, and $5 at Mohegan Sun.

/limits/minTotal/countSideBets.note: Whether side bets count toward the minimum is undocumented (rules spec §9 #11).

/chips.note: The player's station shows eight chips at this denomination: $1, $2, $3, $5, $10, $25, $50 and $100 (research interblock-station-photo-2026-10-30.md); IB §5.1 says chip values scale with denomination.

/catalog/pass.note: Placed only before the come-out roll; a contract bet once the point is set.

/catalog/pass/afterWin.note: A resolved winning bet's chips are "pushed" to the next round.

/catalog/come.note: Placed after a point is set; a contract bet once it travels.

/catalog/come/window.note: Taken only in the point phase (rules spec §3.1); the IB §2.4 text also allows a Come bet after the pass point is made (rules spec §9 #26).

/catalog/come/afterWin.note: A winning come bet is paid and returned; Interblock does not say (rules spec §5.2).

/catalog/passOdds.note: Behind the Pass Line, by multiplier pop-up or by hand; adjustable until resolved.

/catalog/passOdds/pays.note: True odds, including 6:1 on 2/12 and 3:1 on 3/11, as on live crapless tables. Interblock pays come from its par sheet, which is not public (rules spec §5.2, §9 #4).

/catalog/passOdds/limit.note: 2x on all ten points ("mostly double"). The cap shows only in the game's odds pop-up (rules spec §9 #4).

/catalog/comeOdds.note: Behind a come bet on its number.

/catalog/comeOdds/pays.note: True odds, including 6:1 on 2/12 and 3:1 on 3/11, as on live crapless tables. Interblock pays come from its par sheet, which is not public (rules spec §5.2, §9 #4).

/catalog/comeOdds/limit.note: 2x on all ten points ("mostly double"). The cap shows only in the game's odds pop-up (rules spec §9 #4).

/catalog/comeOdds/comeOutDefault.note: Come odds are OFF on the come-out and returned if the come bet is decided, as on live tables; undocumented for Interblock (rules spec §9 #5).

/catalog/place.note: Place bets on all ten points, on any roll.

/catalog/place/pays.note: The standard 9:5, 7:5 and 7:6 on 4 to 10, as on Shoot To Win and live tables. Interblock v2.5.1 removed its pay tables, and its par sheet is not public (rules spec §5.2).

/catalog/place/pays/9.note: The player's station prints "PLACE 12 FOR 5" under NINE: 7:5 (research interblock-station-photo-2026-10-30.md).

/catalog/place/pays/2.note: 11:2, the better of the two published crapless pays (5:1 per CROWN-CL); the Interblock par sheet is not public (rules spec §9 #4).

/catalog/place/pays/12.note: 11:2, the better of the two published crapless pays (5:1 per CROWN-CL); the Interblock par sheet is not public (rules spec §9 #4).

/catalog/place/pays/3.note: 11:4, the better of the two published crapless pays (13:5 per CROWN-CL); the Interblock par sheet is not public (rules spec §9 #4).

/catalog/place/pays/11.note: 11:4, the better of the two published crapless pays (13:5 per CROWN-CL); the Interblock par sheet is not public (rules spec §9 #4).

/catalog/place/afterWin.note: A winning bet stays up (rules spec §5.2); Interblock does not say.

/catalog/place/comeOutDefault.note: Place and buy bets work on the come-out unless set OFF (rules spec §0.2 #4).

/catalog/buy.note: Buy bets on all ten points pay true odds with commission.

/catalog/buy/commission.note: 5% of the bet, paid up front: on crapless machines "most require a 5% commission to be paid upfront on all Buy wagers".

/catalog/buy/commission/timing.note: GV6.5 up-front commission pop-up; answering NO removes the bet.

/catalog/buy/commission/rounding.note: A sub-cent commission rounds up to the cent (rules spec §4.2); 5% of a whole-dollar bet never needs it.

/catalog/buy/commission/minimum.note: No minimum: machines charge an exact 5%.

/catalog/buy/commission/refundOnTakeDown.note: Not refunded on take-down: the conservative choice (rules spec §9 #3).

/catalog/buy/commission/rearm.note: Re-collected from the win when a winning buy stays up: the conservative choice, and it decides place vs buy on 5/9 (rules spec §9 #3).

/catalog/buy/afterWin.note: A winning bet stays up (rules spec §5.2); Interblock does not say.

/catalog/buy/comeOutDefault.note: Place and buy bets work on the come-out unless set OFF (rules spec §0.2 #4).

/catalog/hard.note: Hard 4, 6, 8 and 10: win on the pair, lose on the easy way or a 7.

/catalog/hard/pays.note: 7:1 on 4/10 and 9:1 on 6/8, the standard pays; the Interblock par sheet is not public.

/catalog/hard/afterWin.note: A winning bet stays up (rules spec §5.2); Interblock does not say.

/catalog/hard/comeOutDefault.note: Hardways work on the come-out unless set OFF; undocumented for Interblock (rules spec §9 #5).

/catalog/field/pays.note: 2:1 on 2 and 12 ("typically ... a double payout"); pay table EL602 pays 3:1 on 12 in standard craps only.

/catalog/field/pays/2.note: The player's station prints the field's 2 circled, "PAYS DOUBLE": 2:1 (research interblock-station-photo-2026-10-30.md). Its 12 is out of the photo.

/catalog/field/afterWin.note: One-roll winners are paid and returned; Keep Bets On and Repeat are UI conveniences (rules spec §9 #19).

/catalog/any7.note: The Seven bet: one roll, any 7.

/catalog/any7/pays.note: The screen shows props as "for 1": 5 (seven), 8 (craps), 16 (eleven, 3, easy hops) and 31 (2, 12, hard hops) for 1.

/catalog/any7/afterWin.note: One-roll winners are paid and returned; Keep Bets On and Repeat are UI conveniences (rules spec §9 #19).

/composites.note: C&E wins on 2, 3, 11 and 12; the Horn field splits the bet equally among the four horn singles.

/sideBets/luckyRollerLow.note: Low Rolls 2 to 6, High Rolls 8 to 12, Roll 'Em All all ten, before any 7; offered on every Interblock game, crapless included.

/sideBets/luckyRollerHigh.note: Low Rolls 2 to 6, High Rolls 8 to 12, Roll 'Em All all ten, before any 7; offered on every Interblock game, crapless included.

/sideBets/luckyRollerAll.note: Low Rolls 2 to 6, High Rolls 8 to 12, Roll 'Em All all ten, before any 7; offered on every Interblock game, crapless included.

/sideBets/luckyRollerLow/pays.note: 30, 30 and 155 to 1: the screen shows Low 31, Roll 'Em All 156 and High 31 for 1 (rules spec §0.2 #10), as the player's own station prints them (research interblock-station-photo-2026-10-30.md).

/sideBets/luckyRollerHigh/pays.note: 30, 30 and 155 to 1: the screen shows Low 31, Roll 'Em All 156 and High 31 for 1 (rules spec §0.2 #10), as the player's own station prints them (research interblock-station-photo-2026-10-30.md).

/sideBets/luckyRollerAll/pays.note: 30, 30 and 155 to 1: the screen shows Low 31, Roll 'Em All 156 and High 31 for 1 (rules spec §0.2 #10), as the player's own station prints them (research interblock-station-photo-2026-10-30.md).

/sideBets/luckyRollerLow/placement.note: Only after a 7 or before the first roll of the history cycle; no new bet of a type after it wins until a 7.

/sideBets/luckyRollerHigh/placement.note: Only after a 7 or before the first roll of the history cycle; no new bet of a type after it wins until a 7.

/sideBets/luckyRollerAll/placement.note: Only after a 7 or before the first roll of the history cycle; no new bet of a type after it wins until a 7.

/sideBets/luckyRollerLow/endsOn.note: Any 7, including a come-out 7, loses the bet.

/sideBets/luckyRollerHigh/endsOn.note: Any 7, including a come-out 7, loses the bet.

/sideBets/luckyRollerAll/endsOn.note: Any 7, including a come-out 7, loses the bet.

/workingToggle.note: "Set bets On/Off" covers Place, Buy, Odds and Hard Ways (Lay is not offered in crapless) and stays until changed.

/workingToggle/perBet.note: IB §3.2 describes only the one Set bets On/Off button; no per-bet toggle is documented.

/comeOut.note: No come-out auto-OFF: place and buy bets work on the come-out (rules spec §0.2 #4).

/afterSevenOut.note: After a 7-out, new Place and Buy bets are set OFF until the player taps Set bets On.

/afterSevenOut/newPlacedOff/trigger.note: "After a 7 (7-out) is rolled" is read as a seven-out only, so place and buy bets made after a come-out 7 work; it may be any 7 (rules spec §9 #6).

/afterSevenOut/newPlacedOff/until.note: "Until the player sets bets ON" is a literal reading; it may instead end when the next point is established (rules spec §9 #6).

/oddsOffReturnedAtPointMade.note: "Odds bets are removed when a Point is reestablished" while set OFF, read as: OFF odds are returned when the point is made. The research marks this reading unverified (core.md §5.1).

/offBets.note: "All placed bets decrease the Playable credit meter regardless of them being set to on or off."

/exclusiveGroups.note: Place and Buy may share a number "when available"; no lay or don't bets to exclude.

/excludeLineVsLayBuy.note: The Pass/Don't Pass vs Lay/Buy exclusion needs lay or don't pass, which crapless lacks.

/payLabelStyle.note: Display only: the player's station prints every pay it shows as "N for M" — place 9 "12 FOR 5", hops "16 FOR 1" and "31 FOR 1", Lucky Roller "31 FOR 1" and "156 FOR 1" (research interblock-station-photo-2026-10-30.md).

/flow/shooter.note: On a single-player machine the player is always the shooter.

/flow/invalidRoll.note: An Interblock patent re-vibrates and re-reads misread dice. Cosmetic: the engine never re-rolls.

/flow/groupButtons.note: Crapless offers Press and Across, after the come-out and only with a Pass, Don't Pass, Field or one-roll bet up.

/flow/historyLength.note: The last-results sidebar length is a setting; 20 is a trainer default.

/flow/macros.note: Repeat Last Bet and Double Bet; Keep Bets On is not in every jurisdiction.

/pace.note: Self-paced with no bet timer; the shooter window does not apply.

/pace/rollsPerHour.note: 120 rolls per hour for a self-paced heads-up game; the coach also shows a 60 to 150 range (rules spec §8.3).
